sections.name: 阅读理解
sections.note: 每题 2 分。阅读所给文章，从四个选项中选出最佳答案。

passage.title: Paying without a smartphone
passage.text: Cashless payment is convenient for anyone who owns a smartphone and frustrating for anyone who does not. Shops that stop accepting cash save time at the counter, but they also exclude older customers and people without a bank account. Several cities have responded with rules requiring retailers to accept cash, and some banks now issue cards with large-print keypads and a single confirmation button. The debate is often framed as progress versus nostalgia. In practice it is a question of design: a payment system is only as good as the number of people who can use it.

sections.note: 本题 12 分。把划线句子译成汉语，要求准确、通顺。

sections.name: 写作
sections.note: 本题 12 分。按题目要求写一篇短文。

items.stem: Write an essay of about 150 words on the following topic: some shops no longer accept cash. Discuss the advantages and disadvantages, and give your opinion.

answer.text: Cashless payment saves time at the counter and reduces the cost of handling notes and coins. For a small shop, those savings are real. The disadvantage is equally real: customers without a smartphone or a bank account are excluded from ordinary shopping, and the exclusion falls hardest on older people. The choice is not between efficiency and nostalgia. It is a design question. Shops can keep fast digital payment while accepting cash at one counter, and banks can issue cards with large print and a single confirmation button. A payment system should be judged by how many people can use it, not by how modern it looks.

explain.right: 先定三段骨架（描述—分析—结论），再把题目给出的信息逐条落进段落，最后检查字数与衔接词。
explain.wrong: 常见错误：只写「无现金很方便」或「老人可怜」，没有给出兼顾效率与包容的具体做法。
